meta.titulo: CodArch · the living map of your software architecture
home.intro: CodArch analyses your repository and draws it: a treemap of files and folders with each block's risk, each function's complexity and the migration debt. The same map appears in the pull request, in CI and in your agent.
home.empezar.desc: Three ways to install it. All of them read the same cc.json with the same checksum.
home.cli.desc: One installation: the CLI carries the web app inside. Analyse, compare and draw from the terminal.
home.web.desc: Only the web app, without installing Node: the published image with your repo mounted read-only. Open it at http://localhost:4173.
home.web.docker: If you have cloned the CodArch repo:
home.desktop.desc: Installer for Windows (.exe) and Linux (.deb and AppImage). Analyses with git against the disk and saves to .codarch/.
home.alpha: Alpha. The functionality is there; the product is not yet. Versions carry prereleases and there is no support.
home.quehay.desc: Everything comes from the same model: cc.json, with its deterministic checksum. The checksum does not depend on who looks, so the map in the PR, in CI and in the agent is the same.
home.pieza.cli.desc: Analyses, compares, draws and serves. Installed with npm i -g codarch, it brings the web app, which opens with codarch serve.
home.pieza.action.desc: Comments on the pull request with the map, the diff and the violations, and blocks if the repo's policy is broken.
home.pieza.mcp.desc: Read-only queries so your agent can ask about the architecture without making anything up.
home.pieza.apps.desc: The map with the inspector, the PR view and the history. The web app analyses through codarch serve (locally or in Docker); the desktop app, against the real disk.
home.pieza.ext.desc: Plugins add views; addons bring declarative knowledge. Neither can touch the model, so the checksum does not change.
home.pieza.reglas.desc: In .codarch.yml: layers, forbidden dependencies, thresholds and cycles. Only the violations introduced block.
home.dentro.desc: The model, the rules, the roadmap and the decisions: each ADR with its roadmap inside and its changelog next to it, straight from the repository.
home.figura.alt: CodArch's atlas over its own repository: each block is a folder or a file, the colour is the risk and the inspector counts the file's symbols.
home.figura.desc: CodArch analysing its own repo: 210 files, 59 folders, the risk per block and the inspector with the file's symbols.
marco.tagline: the living map of the architecture
marco.licencia: CodArch is free software under MIT. The trademark is not granted with the licence.
guia.hero.desc: What has been thought through and what is left. Every day is a changelog: its additions, its fixes and the rest, with the verdict for each idea.
guia.normas.pie: the legend, the categories and the rules.
guia.normas.desc: The legend, the categories, the verdicts and the rules. The guide is the changelog: each idea is a file with its date, its category and its verdict.
guia.futuro.desc: Ideas waiting their turn: they are here because they are not lost, not because the work is done. Each one leads to the day it was written.
